result.title: TalentRL: Strategy-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Hierarchical Skill Routing
result.summary: Natural-language skills enable large language model (LLM) agents to reuse procedures across tasks, yet most systems retrieve individual skills from a flat SkillBank without explicitly modeling the high-level strategy that governs their selection and use. We introduce TalentRL, a strategy-guided reinforcement learning framework for hierarchical routing over procedural memory. Coarse-grained talents represent recurring strategies for skill use, while fine-grained skills provide executable procedures. For each task, the policy model selects a talent that guides execution and softly prioritizes its associated skills during similarity-based retrieval. However, since task outcomes depend jointly on talent selection, retrieved skill context, and downstream execution, terminal rewards alone cannot isolate the contribution of the routing decision. TalentRL therefore trains talent routing with reward contrasts between rollouts of the same task under matched interventions on the talent-conditioned context, and optimizes downstream execution with group-relative advantages. Across seven open-domain and multi-hop question-answering benchmarks, talent-aware supervised fine-tuning improves average success rate by 7.53%, 6.71%, and 9.21% over the corresponding zero-shot baselines for Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen3-8B, and Llama-3.1-8B, respectively. Reinforcement learning further improves these SFT checkpoints by 7.58% to 9.32%, and TalentRL achieves the highest average success rate among all compared methods on all three backbones. On the agentic benchmarks ALFWorld and WebShop, TalentRL achieves the highest ALFWorld success rate (99.3%) and the highest WebShop score (90.7) among all compared methods.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 TalentRL：在 LLM agent 的程序性记忆上做分层路由，由粗粒度 talent 选择策略引导细粒度 skill 的相似度检索，并用同一任务下对 talent 条件上下文做匹配干预的 rollout 奖励对比来训练路由，下游执行则用 group-relative 优势优化，在多个 QA 与 ALFWorld/WebShop 上评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 任务结果混合了路由、检索上下文与执行三方面影响，其「匹配干预下的奖励对比」为隔离单一决策贡献提供了可核查的监督思路，可能迁移到 LVR 中 latent 内容对答案贡献的分配与训练；但该工作为纯文本 agent，无显式视觉状态或 latent 推理过程。
